settings.gift_copy: The Bible Band is a favorite for baptisms, graduations, confirmations, and new believers. There is nothing to set up and no app to download — they just tap and go. You can add a free gift note in your cart.
settings.mark_testimonial_quote: What can I say about the Bible Band except that, in my opinion, it's about as close to perfect as you can get. … With one tap using your smartphone, you're taken directly to Scripture, a daily devotional, and prayer. It only takes a few minutes each day, but the time you invest can have a lasting impact. … It has genuinely enriched my daily Bible reading, prayer time, and personal walk with the Lord.
settings.mix_note: Mix any sizes and colors — your discount applies automatically.
settings.preorder_copy: This band is on the way. Order now and it is expected to ship in 3–4 weeks. If your pack mixes preorder and in-stock bands, the whole order ships together when all bands are ready. Need it sooner? Choose a size and style marked “Ships now.”
settings.problem_copy: Quiet time is easy to plan—and easy to forget. The Bible Band keeps a simple reminder on your wrist: notice it, tap it, and today’s Scripture, devotion, and prayer are ready.
settings.problem_heading: Keep forgetting your time with God?

settings.size_help_copy: Most adults should choose Adult. Choose Adult XL if standard watch bands usually feel tight or you regularly need extended-length bands. If you’re between sizes, size up. For the best fit, wrap a strip of paper snugly around your wrist, mark where it overlaps, then lay it flat against a ruler.
